exchangeDetails.description: Kraken is a centralized cryptocurrency exchange registered in United States. Is Kraken safe? Kraken security rating is low with 90% security score.

topRisks.content: The absence of CCSS certification leaves crypto custody controls unvalidated, increasing the risk of undetected security gaps.
Missing penetration testing leaves the system without independent validation, increasing the likelihood that hidden security flaws remain undetected.

recentChanges.content: The cookie flag score is improved, meaning cookies are now set more securely to better protect user sessions.
The password policy is updated, requiring stronger passwords and improving overall account security.
The HTTP headers score is improved, adding better protections against common web attacks.
